Name: Custom Linens
Author: Mevima
Description:
UPDATE: v1.1. Mod now includes kids' beds and single bed, and will be effective from the beginning of the game.

Simple mod based on/requiring SMAPI that allows you to change your bedspread to something that suits your farmer better. Currently, changing the linens requires you to edit the config.json file and reload the game, but future versions plan to integrate a chest full of linens so you can change it while you're playing!

Options include Black Satin, Desert, Dragon, Green Stripes, and Pink Floral, and change the double bed, single bed, kids' beds, and crib, while adding a dish towel to the kitchen.

See the included README.txt for full installation/uninstall instructions, as well as how you can use this mod without SMAPI.

KNOWN ISSUE: The same image is used for the kids' beds, your first single bed, and several beds in town. This means when you change the linens, you'll also change the linens of some of your neighbours. At this point, I can't see any way around it.
